column1: # grab_manifest.tsv: what STRONG.EXE grab makes of each source file, one row per STRONG.DAT entry.
# Generated by reversing/scripts/ungrab_check.py --write-manifest from a run of the original packer.
# Do not edit; regenerate. Read by sh_formats::grab. Names are DOS paths as grab opens them, case folded.
# dat    md5 size entries               the container the manifest was traced against
# exe    md5                            the STRONG.EXE whose packer was run
# anim   file load_x descriptors        3000:3580's descriptors x00:xstep:frames:marked, up to the first empty one
# cut    n file kind x0 y0 x1 y1 load_x edits   a rectangle, inclusive, in frame coordinates
# pal    n file at size edits           palette bytes stashed from palette offset at
# font   n file                         the font record 2000:2a25 parses out of the sheet
# samp   n file load_x edits offsets    single pixels at these frame offsets
# snd    n file                         a kind 3 audio record
# copy   n file pad                     the whole file, and 15 zero bytes after it when pad is 1
# edits: in the order the packer applied them; a>b recolour, rot the 3000:bc00 colour swap, - none
